# Focal Forensics

> Professional digital forensic services specializing in audio, video, and image analysis for criminal and civil legal cases with CJIS-compliant evidence handling.

Focal Forensics is a certified forensic laboratory (ASCLD/ANAB 17025) providing expert media analysis and enhancement services to law enforcement, government agencies, and district attorneys. The company specializes in evidence authentication, redaction compliance, and critical incident video analysis for legal proceedings.

## Key Topics

- Digital forensics
- Video redaction
- Audio redaction
- CJIS compliance
- FOIA compliance
- Evidence authentication
- Forensic analysis
- Audio enhancement
- Image enhancement
- Critical incident video
- Law enforcement
- Digital evidence
- Voice enhancement
- HIPAA compliance
- Forensic experts

## Core Forensic Services

- [Audio Services](https://focalforensics.com/audio-services): Audio enhancement, authentication, and transcription services for forensic evidence analysis.
- [Video Services](https://focalforensics.com/video-services): Video enhancement, authentication, and analysis services for forensic evidence presentation.
- [Image Services](https://focalforensics.com/image-services): Image enhancement, authentication, and facial comparison services for forensic analysis.

## Redaction & Compliance

- [Redaction Services](https://focalforensics.com/redaction-services): CJIS-compliant secure redaction services for videos, audio, and images.
- [Redaction Resources](https://focalforensics.com/audio-video-redaction-resources): Educational resources on audio and video redaction methods, FOIA, and HIPAA compliance.

## Specialized Services

- [Critical Incident Video Services](https://focalforensics.com/critical-incident-videos): Specialized video forensics services for critical incidents and law enforcement transparency.
